component.name: TarDrop
component.summary: Install portable application archives into your home folder

description.p: TarDrop installs portable Linux applications shipped as .tar, .tar.gz, .tgz, .tar.xz, .tar.bz2, or .zip archives. Drop an archive onto its window and it is extracted beneath ~/Applications, with a launcher added to your desktop’s application menu. Everything stays in your home directory, and nothing needs root.

ul.li: Every member path is validated; absolute paths and “..” are never written
Symbolic links, hard links, and install.sh scripts trigger a risk review before anything is extracted
Nothing from the archive is run during installation
Update checks contact the network only when you ask, or when you switch automatic checks on
